newsitem.title: USA: U.S. late Midcontinent spot prods fall with NYMEX - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: U.S. late Midcontinent spot prods fall with NYMEX - Feb 12.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot product fell after a reversal in NYMEX futures prices late Wednesday, with differentials narrowly mixed in subdued trade, players said.
"There wasn't a lot of activity going on in the Group or Chicago," one trader said, saying the market lost direction following Tuesday's deadline for scheduling.
"After scheduling things always get quiet," the trader said.
